lifecycle.description: Explicit phase. PENDING is not FAIL: a receipt awaiting an ACK inside its budget has not failed yet. EXPIRED means the budget elapsed with a legal budget; REJECTED means the ACK arrived but did not bind.

submission_state.description: Original sender diagnostic, including native receipt or queue state; null before dispatch. Busy work does not prohibit communication. No diagnostic alone authorizes replay; reconcile the original attempt.

detector_side.description: Which side observed the condition. A supervisor-side abort must never be reported as executor silence.

budget_source.description: Which budget governed the original poll. The first two values are emitted by the current harness; older values remain readable. A generic --timeout overrides the phase default.

budget_seconds.description: The effective budget in seconds, as used, not as defaulted.

phase_minimum_seconds.description: The phase floor (handshake 600, round 180). When budget_seconds is below this, a timeout must not be attributed to executor silence.

budget_below_phase_minimum.description: True when budget_seconds < phase_minimum_seconds. Requires reason SUPERVISOR_BUDGET_TOO_SHORT rather than HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT.

task_pack_sha256.description: Binds the receipt to the exact pack content it was issued for, so a later pack edit cannot silently inherit an old ACK.

source_revision.description: Repository revision the executor was asked to work against.

clear_confirmed.description: Legacy bridge diagnostic field; not proof that a fresh handshake ran a probe.

bridge_clear_confirmed.description: Null when no optional probe ran. True only for a cleared original probe or its verified original recovery; never inferred from handshake success.

dispatch_submitted_at.description: Null before dispatch or when the sender returned an error or uncertain result. It does not establish zero input; inspect the original journal and native evidence.

freshness.description: Derived evidence must not predate its inputs. A validation summary older than the receipt it summarizes is not current evidence.
